facts: Parties: Northgate Retail Group plc (Buyer), Vantage Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Merrion Medical Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 17 December 2025; Closing is scheduled for 14 March 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Eskdale Systems Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,380,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $98,760,000.
